meta.name: Dryer
meta.description: Dryer. It supports only drying-related functions.

start_cycle.description: The program argument has the single value dry_only. Start the dry_only cycle while powered and idle or completed. Set cycle_mode to dry_only, status to running, phase to dry, progress_minutes to zero, started_at_minute to the current elapsed minute, and remaining_minutes to drying_duration. Configuration remains fixed until completion, including while paused. Invalid arguments or failed preconditions leave all state unchanged.

tick.description: While powered and running, calculate progress as elapsed minutes minus started_at_minute, clamped between zero and the declared drying_duration. Keep phase dry until the configured duration is reached. Update progress_minutes and remaining_minutes accordingly; at the final boundary set status and phase to completed and remaining_minutes to zero. Idle, paused, completed and unpowered cycles do not advance. Preserve all settings. While powered and running, contribute 48 dBA for normal drying or 43 dBA for gentle drying. Contribute zero whenever unpowered or not running. Apply the absolute noise contribution each time, including zero to clear previous output. Return this noise output solely as a set_contribution effect for the containing Home Space noise property, in dBA.

effect_properties.name: power
effect_properties.description: Determines whether the process advances and produces noise.

effect_properties.name: drying_duration
effect_properties.description: Determines the total dry-only process duration.

effect_properties.name: drying_mode
effect_properties.description: Determines normal or gentle drying noise.

effect_properties.name: status
effect_properties.description: Gates advancement and becomes completed at the end.

effect_properties.name: started_at_minute
effect_properties.description: Running-time origin used to calculate progress.

effect_properties.name: progress_minutes
effect_properties.description: Completed drying minutes, clamped to the configured duration.

effect_properties.name: remaining_minutes
effect_properties.description: Configured duration minus completed drying minutes.

after_action.description: This hook has two separate action-dependent branches. After set_power switches power off while the process status is running, set status=paused and preserve phase, progress, remaining time and origin. Restoring power does not resume a paused process and does not rebase the origin. After start_cycle or resume_cycle transitions status from a non-running value to running while powered, set started_at_minute to the current elapsed world minute minus progress_minutes. pause_cycle preserves the origin and progress. These are conditional branches of the shared hook; there is no origin update caused by set_power. Emit no Space effects.

effect_properties.name: status
effect_properties.description: Identifies transitions into running and power-loss pauses.

effect_properties.name: started_at_minute
effect_properties.description: Running-time origin established on start or resume.

effect_properties.name: progress_minutes
effect_properties.description: Retained progress used to establish the running-time origin.
